Name: StormDrakon's Lung Dragons - Fixed
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Okay so I posted this a couple days ago, not having realized StormDrakon had already updated their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5761]Lung Dragons[/url]. However, it appears their version is broken, according to a bunch of comments, and as it hasn't been updated in almost 2 years, and permissions remain open, I decided to reupload my version, which I believe has fixed all the bugs from Storm's version. If they come back and want me to take this down, I of course will.

So! There are a whopping 19 dragons in this mod. They live in barns, and produce *deep breath*:

River: Super Cucumber, Pearl
Abyss: Void Essence, Neptunite
Celestial: Solar Essence, Star Shards
Creek: Energy Tonic, Truffle Oil
Crystal: Qi Gem, Fairy Dust
Dune:  Ginger, Ginger Ale
Flower: Honey, Fairy Rose
Forest: Fiddlehead Fern, Mahogany Seed
Lava: Magma Geode, Cinder Shards
Meadowlands: Ginger, Ginger Ale
Mountain: Omni Geode, Diamond
Phase: Ectoplasm, Prismatic Jelly
Pond: Rainbow Shell, Caviar
Pygmy: Ginger, Ginger Ale
Radioactive: Radioactive Ore, Radioactive Bar
Sky: Duck Feather, Prismatic Shard
Spectre: Ghost Crystal, Ectoplasm
Storm: Battery Pack
Time: Ancient Fruit, Sweet Gem Berry

Whew. Okay. Now, since they produce rarer stuff, they're pretty expensive. But, a good investment imo! I'd also recommend using Ship Anything (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3782) since some of the items are quest items with no real value otherwise. 

Enjoy!
